surface_b_method: MANUAL EXPORT is the primary path — claude.ai > Settings > Analytics > 'How much is Claude costing?' > Export spend report > Last Month, then drop the CSV into raw/<YYYY-MM>/overage_spend.csv. The authenticated in-page fetch (see SKILL.md) is an optional automation over an UNOFFICIAL endpoint.
surface_b_requires: A manual monthly export by an admin, OR (optional automation) an Owner/Primary Owner claude.ai session in Claude-in-Chrome.
notes: org_id is filled by the setup flow (grab it from your claude.ai admin URL). plan_tier: 'team' uses the manual/browser Surface B path above; 'enterprise' uses fetch_surface_b_enterprise.py against the documented Analytics API and never touches a browser.
